purpose: Define the ONLY approval phrase the operator may use to unlock the next stage. This phrase does NOT authorize execution. It authorizes a strictly read-only wallet-address dry run.
what_approval_unlocks: The next stage (LP_BSC_10_20U_PROBE_WALLET_ADDRESS_DRY_RUN_V1) may read the operator-supplied wallet address.
That next stage may call ERC20.allowance(owner=wallet, spender=NPM) to determine if approve is needed.
That next stage may call ERC20.balanceOf(wallet) for USDT and WBNB to confirm balance sufficient.
That next stage may call eth_estimateGas with from=wallet for approve / mint / decrease / collect / revoke.
That next stage produces a refined gas + cost forecast and a tighter unsigned tx package.
what_approval_does_NOT_unlock: Calling approve / mint / increaseLiquidity / decreaseLiquidity / collect / burn / swap.
Writing to any production lpbot table.
Probe execution. Execution is a further stage that does not yet have a spec.
forbidden_alternative_phrases_must_be_re: ANY phrase that does not match the regex ^APPROVE_BSC_10_20U_PROBE_DRY_RUN_WITH_WALLET_ADDRESS_ONLY wallet=0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40} notional=(10|20)$
what_operator_must_confirm_BEFORE_typing: I have read the candidate review, risk limits, telemetry spec, dry-run builder spec, this approval checkpoint, the unsigned tx package, and the gas feasibility report.
I accept that realistic_positive_ev = false; this probe is a channel/telemetry investment, not a profit trade.
The wallet address I am about to type:
- has a USDT + WBNB balance summing to AT MOST $25 (20U notional + ~$5 gas/slippage buffer)
- is NOT a multi-sig, NOT a shared wallet, NOT a cold-storage main treasury
I confirm no lpbot-live / lpbot-canary / lpbot-paper / other production process is running on this host.
I have set BSC_RPC_PRIMARY to a paid endpoint, OR I explicitly accept publicnode for the upcoming wallet-address dry run only.
I understand approving this phrase does NOT authorize execution. A further stage with its own spec + approval is required before any tx is signed or sent.
after_approval_what_next_stage_logs: The exact approval phrase typed (including the wallet address).
The block number at which the next stage starts.
The wallet's USDT balance + WBNB balance + USDT allowance + WBNB allowance for the NPM spender.
The eth_estimateGas results for each tx in the round-trip.
A new unsigned tx package with the wallet address filled in (but recipient inside calldata still as that wallet ONLY for simulation; no signing, no sending).
approval_recipient_for_logging: lp_probe_preflight_review_v1.human_approval_received + human_approval_at (as defined in Phase E telemetry spec; table not yet created)
